Smooth, mellow coffee concentrate made without heat. Start it the night before.

== Ingredients ==
* 100 g coarsely ground coffee
* 1 litre cold filtered water

== Method ==
# Stir the coffee and water together in a large jar until all the grounds are wet.
# Cover and leave at room temperature for 12 to 18 hours.
# Strain through a fine sieve lined with a paper filter or a clean cloth. Be patient and do not press the grounds.
# Keep the concentrate in the fridge and use it within a week.
# To serve, dilute 1 part concentrate with 1 to 2 parts cold water or milk, over ice.

== Tips ==
* The grounds should look like coarse salt. Finer grounds make a muddy, bitter brew and clog the filter.
* Steeping for much longer than 18 hours tends to taste woody.
